objective: Explore hardware designs through the same parameter discovery, Python simulation, synthesis and RTL interface. Keep workload/checks fixed and search policy outside the tools. This demo verifies CPU execution and evidence handling, not live hardware.

environment.method: Sequential calls; three fresh Python attempts per design; first-use imports included; no speedup inference.

dc_bias.definition: Mean fixed-point output for the stopband waveform.

passband_sndr_db.definition: 10 log10(positive least-squares delayed-input fitted power / residual AC power).

stopband_atten_db.definition: 20 log10(mean passband magnitude / worst inclusive stopband FFT-bin magnitude); finite [-300,300] dB convention.

stopband_rej_db.definition: 10 log10(stopband input power * mean passband magnitude squared / output AC power).

throughput_samp_per_cyc.definition: Steady-state compute-only lane estimate, excluding transport/startup; NOT measured Python or RTL cycles.

review_criteria.label: Shared CPU execution and negative controls
review_criteria.evidence: FIR and MemCopy each execute two parameter points plus a repeated attempt. Invalid parameters are rejected; unavailable synthesis cannot be reused as a successful RTL artifact. See all attempt records.

review_criteria.label: Wall time distinguished from design timing
review_criteria.evidence: Fresh wall_seconds on every attempt. MemCopy end_cycles is model simulation end, not last completion. FIR throughput is analytic. These runs do not estimate a hardware speedup.

review_criteria.label: Synthesis-to-RTL continuity
review_criteria.evidence: Live adapters are not integrated. No generated RTL, hardware resource observation or RTL correctness proof.

review_criteria.label: DSE or agent advantage
review_criteria.evidence: Fixed demonstration points, not an optimizer benchmark. No model calls or equal-budget search comparison.
